verdict.rationale: Snyk offers AI-driven risk scoring/prioritization (snyk-docs-4, snyk-docs-17) and can visualize issue flow for explanation (snyk-docs-3), plus DeepCode AI-powered analysis (snyk-docs-14, snyk-docs-15) and an LLM Remediation Agent that scans and generates fix plans (snyk-docs-12, snyk-docs-29). However there is no explicit evidence of AI deduplicating findings or explicitly flagging false positives — only manual suppression via 'ignore suggested fixes' (snyk-docs-5), and community feedback notes noisy/low-context alerts (snyk-comm-9, snyk-comm-10) suggesting triage assistance is limited in practice. Missing for 10: AI-driven deduplication of findings, explicit false-positive detection/flagging by AI, and independent confirmation that the risk scoring reduces noise as claimed.
